answer: Sybil resistance comes from a per-identity vault stake the chain can seize. Attestations count only if the agent locked real value under its own key, and weight follows that amount. Forging ten thousand approving identities means opening ten thousand vaults, each funded above the floor: cost scales with fake voices, not one cheap script. Auditors pull the thread of a vote cluster and require proof each vault was funded independently, so recycling one balance fails. Slashed stake pays the catcher, so a Sybil must lock more than it chases, making each puppet a walnut of exposed capital.
